title: Data Protection Professional
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
This role supports daily data protection and privacy activities. This role is designed for early‑career privacy professionals who already possess foundational knowledge and can execute tasks with guidance and increasing independence.
Assist in RoPA documentation and data protection assessments (DPIA, LIA, SPA, TIA) in line with regulatory requirements, internal standards, and service expectations
Participate in third party management activities, under the direction of senior team members
Support privacy-by-design documentation and relevant activities
Support monitoring activities for control effectiveness oversight operating effectiveness
Assist in drafting training materials, guidelines, and communications.
Key Capabilities / Experience
Foundational understanding of data protection & privacy concepts
Experience working with structured data protection processes or assessment tools
Clear written communication skills
High attention to detail & quality orientation
Minimum Qualifications
2-4 years in a data protection & privacy role
Background in technology, information security, risk management, or legal
Data protection & privacy training
